blocks.text: ILOILO CITY — The Police Regional Office 6 (PRO6) seized nearly P4.74 million worth of suspected shabu, accounted for 31 firearms, and arrested 30 individuals during a 24-hour intensified anti-criminality campaign across Western Visayas. According to the PRO6 Regional Operational Accomplishment Dashboard covering 6 a.m. on November 24 to 5:59 a.m. on November 25, police operatives conducted six anti-illegal drug operations. These resulted in the arrest of seven drug personalities and the confiscation of 696.89 grams of suspected shabu estimated to be valued at P4,738,852.
